title: The Apollo house band and rock and roll acts
summary: The Apollo's house band could not play the new rock-and-roll groups, so Schiffman used a small house band and let acts bring their own musicians.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Well he was later. That was the ending of the Apollo Theater. He stayed in there for a long while. I forget his name.
He died in Hawaii (inaudible) on the road some place. Light fella, saxophone player. He stayed in there.
The last days of the Apollo Theater -- what

was so pitiful about, these fellas had the band in the Apollo, they didn't keep up with what was going on. What was really happening, you know. This is -- now you got -- come out of the rock and roll and the what? Rhythm and blues into the rock and roll, right? Now '40's, 50's and the 52 -- you know, coming (inaudible) when we were really making these rock and roll records, well they still had house bands in the Apollo. Groups like Louie and them people would come in the Apollo. They couldn't use the house band. They used their own band.

Now you got these big groups that come in, got these hot records, these rock and roll records; all together a different style from what the house band musicians could play. And it was really hard for them to play these bands' act, because you understand, this was a different type of music. This ain't like the big

bands. You got musicians, guys (inaudible) could play big bands.
Now here come a band coming up with these rock and roll things, the Bill Haley type of things.
You know, real wild stuff, you know. Guitar players. It was real rock and roll things. Like, you know, they come in there with this new stuff, you know.
And the bands couldn't play it, you know. They (inaudible) complain on the house bands, they couldn't play the music.
So what Schiffman (inaudible) would do, they would try to get a smaller band, about ten pieces and let the group bring their own musicians in, you know. The guys that back up the groups, you know.
In this way, they have like, the groups will have their own band down in front on the stage mostly (inaudible) like that. And just use the house band to play other acts.
